Third-Gen Fiat Strada X Adopts the Grande Panda Styling But Remains Extremely Practical Even in CGI
7 photos
Photo: kdesignag / Instagram
America has a special relation with pickup trucks; there is no doubt about it. Alas, there are particularities with this affair. North America loves the humongous beasts like the Ford Super Duty and the Ram 1500 TRX SRT or the Toyota Tacoma. South America, meanwhile, likes them smaller and nimbler.
Latin America has a culture for pickup trucks just like North America, but over there it’s not all about who has the biggest towed trailer or the most prestigious trim level. It’s also about everyday passenger car-like agility blended with real utility, and at a price that doesn’t require selling a villa or an arm and a leg.
That’s why models like the Fiat Strada , Ram 700, Volkswagen Saveiro, Chevrolet Montana, Fiat Toro, Ram Rampage, or the Renault Oroch thrive across the continent, offering good fuel economy, rugged styling without bulkiness, and massive variety plus a great work-to-weekend ratio. It’s no wonder that Volkswagen, for example, is striving to expand its offerings with the all-new Tukan, or Fiat is offering both the Strada and Toro.
Actually, the Fiat Strada coupe utility is also known as the Ram 700 in markets like Mexico. It’s been around since 1998 across two generations, with the current one launched in production in Brazil in 2020. It has already gone through an encompassing mid-cycle refresh procedure for the 2024 model year, so everyone – including the rumor mill – expects the Italians to come up with a brand-new generation sometime around the 2028 model year to make sure it remains competitive.
Naturally, that also attracted the attention of the members of the imaginative guild of digital car content creators, and one of them decided to stop dwelling across the parallel universes of vehicular CGI to envision the upcoming third-generation Fiat Strada in their latest unofficial, hypothetical design project.
More precisely, Kleber Silva, a Brazil-based virtual artist known as " KDesign AG " on social media, has decided to have a CGI go at imagining the next-gen coupe utility and dubbed it Fiat Strada X to stand out in any wishful-thinking crowd. According to the pixel master, the next iteration could be inspired by the funky and recent Fiat Grande Panda supermini, which is based on the Stellantis Smart Car platform shared with the likes of the Fiat Grizzly, Citroen C3, and the latest Opel Frontera.
It could easily adopt both the architecture and the pixel-style exterior design, and the CGI expert even went as far as to create two distinct versions – the double-cab Ranch model featuring a T200 MHEV powertrain (1.0-liter 3-cylinder turbo with 12V BSG packing up to 130 hp) and the work-focused Endurance single-cab model. So, what do you think – yay or nay? View this post on Instagram A post shared by KDesign AG - (@kdesignag)
